tagline: Learn → Experiment → Build → Ideate → Hack → Showcase
heroDescription: Experience quantum computing through Qiskit — learn the fundamentals, build and break quantum circuits, develop your own idea, and turn it into a working quantum solution.

about.heading: Experience Quantum Computing
about.description: Qiskit Fall Fest 2026 is designed as a journey from “Can a classical computer solve this?” to “What changes when we think quantum?” Participants learn quantum computing and Qiskit, experiment with guided projects, deliberately break and analyze their circuits, and then apply what they learned to a Quantum Hackathon.

items.title: Learn & Experiment
items.desc: Explore quantum foundations, Qiskit, circuits, superposition, entanglement and interference through hands-on experiments.

items.title: Build → Break → Rebuild
items.desc: Modify working quantum circuits, observe what changes, explain the results, and rebuild with a better understanding.

items.title: Guided Mini-Project
items.desc: Build a complete quantum project with Qiskit, from the problem and classical approach to execution, results and analysis.

items.title: Quantum Hackathon
items.desc: Move from independent ideation to team-based development, mentoring, experimentation and a final Quantum Showcase.

schedule.heading: Learn → Build → Ideate → Hack

sessions.title: From Bits to Qubits — Speaker Session

schedule.tagline: Click on a day to view the full schedule

items.title: Beginner Qiskit Workshop
items.desc: Learn qubits, quantum states, gates, superposition, measurement and quantum circuits, then run your first Qiskit experiments.

items.title: Build → Break Lab
items.desc: Modify working quantum circuits, predict outcomes, execute them, compare results and reason about why the behavior changed.

items.title: Intermediate Qiskit
items.desc: Explore multi-qubit systems, controlled operations, CNOT gates, entanglement, Bell states and quantum correlations.

items.title: Quantum Algorithms
items.desc: Explore classical search and Grover’s Search Algorithm through oracles, amplitude amplification, interference and Qiskit implementation.

items.title: Guided Mini-Project
items.desc: Follow a complete quantum project from problem and classical approach to quantum algorithm, Qiskit circuit, execution, results and rebuild.

items.title: Ideation & Mentoring
items.desc: Develop a hackathon idea around a problem, quantum opportunity and Qiskit solution with mentor guidance on feasibility and scope.

register.heading: Be Part of Qiskit Fall Fest 2026
register.subtext: Join the four-day journey from learning quantum fundamentals to building, experimenting, ideating and showcasing a Qiskit-based solution.
